narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate on the landing book-map: captures the primordial genesis of life on Pandora at the prebiotic interface — a wide coastal mineral terrace with steaming hydrothermal tidepools beneath Polyphemus, where the raw geology of a young moon first met self-assembling chemistry.
subject: A primordial volcanic shoreline on early Pandora, with stepped mineral terraces and steaming hydrothermal pools descending toward a dark, calm ancient ocean. The shallow pools gleam with concentric mineral crusts of silica, iron sulfide, and sulfur, glowing with faint teal and amber chemiluminescence. Soft plumes of geothermal steam curl across the dark basaltic rock shelves into the cool night air.
scene: An expansive, atmospheric coastal vista of young lifeless Pandora under a deep twilight sky. Low on the distant horizon above the sea, the massive cream-and-indigo silhouette of the gas giant Polyphemus looms softly through the atmospheric haze, casting a gentle pale reflection across the dark water.
camera: A wide establishing landscape shot from a low vantage near the edge of a steaming mineral pool, looking across the terrace tiers toward the ocean and the horizon.
light: Deep indigo twilight ambiance with soft ambient glow from Polyphemus; faint internal teal and cyan chemiluminescence from the mineral pools, and a warm amber ember glow where geothermal vents meet the water, illuminating rising wisps of steam.
palette: Void-indigo and deep teal-indigo rock and sky, pale stone and crystal mineral rims, with living teal and cyan in the pool waters and scarce ember amber along the steaming vent mouths.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, rich atmospheric depth and layered haze, the feel of an expedition field study of a primordial world.
detail_level: Crisp and heavily textured on the foreground mineral terrace and crystalline pool crusts, softening into atmospheric haze and deep shadow toward the ocean and distant sky.
composition: Expansive 16:9 landscape spread with the steaming mineral terrace filling the lower half, the dark ocean stretching across the middle ground, and the crescent curve of Polyphemus low in the upper right sky.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette, painterly not photographic; a primordial, entirely abiotic landscape before macrobiology evolved. Distinct from the lightless deep-sea vent field of figure 01.
